review_rule: partial_is_fail; each profile passes only if every owner-bound component passes in one saved image

pr_environmental_portrait_subject_place.owner: adult woman, the mounting bench and botanical workroom in the same frame

components.evidence: Her face and both hands are readable at environmental portrait scale.
Specimen drawers, pressed leaves, labels and mounting papers identify the workroom.
Her hands work on the folio and ruler at the mounting bench amid specimen materials.
Window, cabinets and broad bench remain visible around the subject.

pr_fabric_tension_fold_attachment.owner: olive canvas apron worn by the adult woman

components.evidence: Canvas weave and matte worn texture are distinguishable on the apron front.
Apron folds begin near the waist seam and pocket attachment, following the tied waist.
Horizontal compression at the waist and angled folds below it are consistent with her slight forward lean.
The apron silhouette is visible, but its tie or fastening closure is obscured behind the body; the full closure relation cannot be verified.

pr_object_contact_shadow_support.owner: brass ruler on the wooden workbench

components.evidence: The full brass ruler and wood worktop are visible together.
A narrow dark line runs along the ruler’s bench-contact edge rather than appearing as detached shading.
The ruler has only a thin dark border at contact; a separate directional soft shadow cannot be resolved clearly enough to verify agreement with the left-side window.
The ruler lies flush along its length on the bench, with no visible floating gap.

limitations: Only the environmental profile was exposed and selected as a pack visual concept; the other two are external target checks, not audited hard pack obligations.
Image-grounded judgments are agent observations, not user acceptance or proof of actual capture provenance.
